approved: Offshore Petroleum and Greenhouse Gas Storage Amendment (Stop PEP11 Forever and Protect Our Coastal Waters) Bill 2024
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would cancel a specific offshore petroleum exploration permit and ban all future petroleum activity in that area.
The Joint Authority, made up of the relevant state and federal ministers, would be blocked from considering or granting any petroleum titles related to that permit.
The permit would automatically end two months after the bill becomes law.
Prohibits the Joint Authority from processing any applications linked to that permit.
Bans the grant of various petroleum titles in the permit area.
The titleholders of PEP11, local communities, tourism businesses, and coastal ecosystems near Newcastle, the Central Coast, and Manly Beach.
